note: Splide UI is the admin interface for the parent Splide module's optionsets. configure route entity.splide.collection at /admin/config/media/splide (list/add/edit/duplicate/delete), plus the splide.settings form at /admin/config/media/splide/ui. It declares the 'administer splide' permission (restrict access: true) that gates all its routes. No config schema or plugins of its own. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the 'administer splide' permission and the splide.settings config (sitewide).

evals.prompt: What permission does Splide UI add, and what does it control? Where is the Splide optionset management screen?
evals.expected_output: Splide UI declares the 'administer splide' permission, which gates all its routes: the optionset collection at /admin/config/media/splide (add/edit/duplicate/delete) and the Splide UI settings form at /admin/config/media/splide/ui.

evals.prompt: The core Splide module defines the optionset config entity but ships no UI. What does the Splide UI submodule provide, and what is its configure route?
evals.expected_output: Splide UI provides the forms to create/edit/duplicate/delete optionsets (collection route entity.splide.collection at /admin/config/media/splide) plus the Splide settings form (route splide.settings at /admin/config/media/splide/ui).

evals.prompt: Which config object does the Splide UI settings form write, and what does it control?
evals.expected_output: It writes the splide.settings config object: module_css (load the module's CSS), splide_css (load the Splide library's CSS), and sitewide (load Splide assets site-wide).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which role has been granted the permission to administer Splide (manage its optionsets)? Inspect the live configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: The role spl_ui_role has the 'administer splide' permission (user.role.spl_ui_role).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is Splide currently configured to load its assets site-wide? Inspect the live Splide settings to answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes: splide.settings sitewide is 1 (Splide assets loaded site-wide).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a role with machine name spl_ui_editor and grant it the permission required to manage Splide slider optionsets through the Splide UI. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A role user.role.spl_ui_editor exists and has the 'administer splide' permission.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, change the Splide settings so that Splide's assets are loaded site-wide. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: splide.settings sitewide is set to a truthy value (1), so Splide assets load site-wide.
